$doc: glaze/offline.md. What the shelf holds and where it goes. Names, not URLs, wherever an upstream can resolve them, so a monthly refresh picks up the new file on its own. Tier 1 is the studio's own work and the small references. Tier 2 is Wikipedia without pictures. Tier 3 is the big library. Sizes are September 2026 and only for planning; the script measures the real thing.

tiers.1: own work, model weights, installers, the small shelf (about 130 GB with the models)
tiers.2: Wikipedia without pictures and the Docker images (about 55 GB)
tiers.3: the full library: Wikipedia with pictures, Stack Overflow, Gutenberg (about 465 GB)

repos.note: Every sibling folder of the glazedweb repo that has a .git is mirrored, bare, from its origin. Folders with no remote (contracts-private, glazed-onchain, glazedweb-permaweb) mirror from the working copy. Uncommitted work is not captured; commit it.

seal.note: Every repo's env files, encrypted as one blob with a passphrase from GLAZE_OFFLINE_KEY. The key is never written anywhere.
